_comment: Index template for `logs-traefik`: the JSON access log.
These fields are typed explicitly because they are what the Traefik and
Sécurité dashboards aggregate on. `ClientHost` as a keyword (not text) is
what makes a terms aggregation over source IPs possible at all.

_meta.ClientHost: Typed as `ip`, not keyword: that enables CIDR range queries during an incident (`ClientHost: "203.0.113.0/24"`), which a keyword cannot do.
_meta.Duration: Nanoseconds, as Traefik emits them. Grafana converts for display; storing the raw value avoids a lossy conversion at ingestion.
